claims: Cameron and Cayden Boozer are five-star twin basketball recruits.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer play for Duke.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer are sons of two-time NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were born in 2007.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were conceived via IVF.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer were conceived to be genetic matches for their older brother Carmani.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer starred at Christopher Columbus High School in Florida.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer won four consecutive state titles.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke in 2024.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer are the sons of former Duke and NBA star Carlos Boozer.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer are the sons of CeCe Boozer.
Carmani is the older brother of Cameron and Cayden Boozer.
Carmani suffered from sickle cell disease.
Umbilical stem cells from Cameron and Cayden Boozer's birth in 2007 were used in a transplant that successfully cured Carmani.
Cameron and Cayden Boozer played for Team USA
